question: Which divine and sage figures are included in this part of the worship?
premises: The sages Sanaka and Sanandana are included.
inference: This part of the worship includes Sarasvatī, the four-faced one, Sanaka, and Sanandana.
uncertainties: The identity of caturvakraṃ is not explicitly specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should include Sarasvatī, the four-faced one, Sanaka, and Sanandana.
